decisions.reason: The source authorizes removal of unauthorized user accounts while retaining three identified accounts; it does not authorize deletion or modification of pages or other content attributed to those users.
The account-retention decision does not change the HLX page-speed goal, scope, or current performance requirements.
The account-retention decision does not change the Legacy site's page-speed goal, scope, or current performance requirements.
The account-retention decision does not alter the requirement to preserve the Legacy site's fonts and formatting.
